headline: Goldman Sachs (GS) Premium Income ETFs Are Beating JPMorgan On Yield And Returns
summary: Goldman Sachs Group (NYSE:GS) premium income ETFs, GPIX and GPIQ, are currently outperforming JPMorgan’s JEPI and JEPQ across expense ratios, dividend yields, and total returns. The comparison highlights competitive advantages for Goldman Sachs products in the premium income ETF category. The performance gap has drawn attention to Goldman Sachs as a growing player in retail income-focused ETFs.
